title: Nats
description: NATS JetStream configuration for OpenLineage events.

natsServers.title: NATS Servers
natsServers.description: NATS server URLs as comma-separated values. Ex: nats://host1:4222,nats://host2:4222

streamName.title: Stream Name
streamName.description: JetStream stream holding the OpenLineage events.

subject.title: Subject Filter
subject.description: Subject to consume from the stream. Defaults to all subjects of the stream.

durableConsumerName.title: Durable Consumer Name
durableConsumerName.description: Durable JetStream consumer name. Reusing it resumes where the previous run stopped.

consumerOffsets.title: Initial Consumer Offsets
consumerOffsets.description: Where a new durable consumer starts reading.

batchSize.title: Fetch Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of events fetched per request.

poolTimeout.title: Single Fetch Call Timeout
poolTimeout.description: Max allowed wait time for a single fetch, in seconds. Must be positive: the run ends once it has waited out sessionTimeout, and a zero wait would never advance that.

sessionTimeout.title: Broker Inactive Session Timeout
sessionTimeout.description: Max allowed inactivity time before the run ends, in seconds.

ackWait.title: Acknowledgement Wait
ackWait.description: How long JetStream waits for an acknowledgement before redelivering an event, in seconds.

maxDeliver.title: Max Delivery Attempts
maxDeliver.description: How many times JetStream redelivers an event that is never acknowledged, before it gives up. Keeps an event that ingestion cannot process from being retried on every run.

authType.title: Authentication Type
authType.description: NATS authentication method. Leave empty for anonymous authentication.

oneOf.title: Username and Password
oneOf.description: Username and password authentication for NATS.

oneOf.title: Credentials File
oneOf.description: Decentralized authentication with the contents of a NATS .creds file (user JWT and NKey seed).

credentials.title: Credentials File Contents
credentials.description: Contents of the .creds file, including the user JWT and the NKey seed.

tlsConfig.title: TLS Configuration
tlsConfig.description: TLS/SSL configuration for secure NATS connections.

oneOf.title: Validate SSL Client Config
oneOf.description: OpenMetadata Client configured to validate SSL certificates.

caCertificate.title: CA Certificate
caCertificate.description: The CA certificate used for SSL validation.

sslCertificate.title: SSL Certificate
sslCertificate.description: The SSL certificate used for client authentication.

sslKey.title: SSL Key
sslKey.description: The private key associated with the SSL certificate.

additionalConfig.title: Additional NATS Config
additionalConfig.description: Additional NATS client configuration options. See https://nats-io.github.io/nats.py/
